comments.author: McOnie
comments.body_html:
Unfortuantely as this is a server mod that changes the stats in the database, there is no menu to adjust the settings. And due to this, you have to restart the server every time you make a change.

You can edit the config file in: SPT > user > mods > WeaponAttachmentModifier > config

comments.body_html: How exactly do i use this. I installed it now what…….

comments.author: McOnie
comments.body_html:
In the mod folder there is a config file that allows you to adjust the values, you can either set a multiplier or override items individually. There are options for Ergonomics and Recoil for Pistol Grips, Stocks and Foregrips and Ergonomics, Recoil and Durability Burn for muzzle devices.

On the main description it will explain how the multipliers work, but as an example if a foregrip has -4 ergo and you set a 2 multiplier it will change the ergo on the foregrip to -2 (-4 / 2 = -2).

I have an update planned to release within the next 24 hours that will add more options to override groups entirely, and an updated description to make it clear how to adjust things.

comments.author: McOnie
comments.body_html:
Sorry for the late reply. Looks like a JSON formatting error, and is my fault for not providing more than 1 example.

You need to put each item within it’s own curly brackets and comma separated within the “SpecificAttachmentOverrides”: [] section, like so:

"SpecificAttachmentOverrides": [
    {
      "ItemId": "5b7d64555acfc4001876c8e2",
      "Name": "SA58 BRS stock",
      "ErgonomicsOverride": 37.0,
      "RecoilPercentageOverride": -50.0
    },
    {
      "ItemId": "5b7be1265acfc400161d0798",
      "Name": "SA58 7.62x51 21 inch barrel",
      "ErgonomicsOverride": 20.0,
      "RecoilPercentageOverride": -20.0
    },
    {
      "ItemId": "5c1bc5af2e221602b412949b",
      "Name": "Zenit RK-2 Foregrip",
      "ErgonomicsOverride": 40.0,
      "RecoilPercentageOverride": -80.0
    }
]

I’ll update the config to make it clear for future users.

comments.author: McOnie
comments.body_html:
The values that adjust the ergonomics and recoil shouldn’t cause this, but I imagine the durability burn is having a significant impact. It’s likely that is you increase that value a lot it’s causing the gun to essentially break after not a lot of shooting causing the jams.

I have an update nearly ready to push that cleans up the logic to how the modifiers work and a restructure of the config. I will also add warnings to specific areas that high values may have unintended results.

There’s also a much better mod that was recently updated to 4.0.* that adjusts recoil is a much better way: https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2190/recoil-rework, the only downside is this doesn’t affect ergonomics (that I’m aware of)
